items.s: Upbit and Bithumb froze SAND transfers under South Korea's user-protection law, with Upbit halting deposits and withdrawals on Ethereum — the chain the studio says was not affected.

items.h: Bitcoin, Ethereum ETFs Draw $2.6 Billion in Biggest Weekly Inflows Since October
AI Has Made Bitcoin Software a Target—This Group Is Fighting Back
items.s: A group of 20-odd developers is scanning the Bitcoin ecosystem for AI-discoverable flaws, warning that cheap, powerful models have handed attackers unprecedented reach.
